backTranslation.ai.consent.a.title: Do you want to turn on the AI log assistant?
backTranslation.ai.consent.a.lead: It uses your entries to create weekly summaries and general meal ideas and explains how the app works. The answers come from AI, not from a human, and it gives no medical advice.
backTranslation.ai.consent.a.sent.title: What is sent
backTranslation.ai.consent.a.sent.body: Before records are sent, we show you the content, and nothing is sent until you tap Send. We send dose counts (on time, late, skipped), the change in the weight you entered yourself, how many times you logged each kind of symptom, the number of days with a meal log together with your protein average and goal, and your streak in weeks. For meal ideas we also send the meal kind, preferences, allergies and disliked foods you choose. Your language and region setting is also sent. Only app help sends the questions you type and the current conversation history, along with the app version, the platform and the current screen.
backTranslation.ai.consent.a.notSent.body: Model requests built from records exclude medication names and doses, notes, recorded food names, photos, dates, names, email addresses and account identifiers. Meal kinds, preferences, allergies and disliked foods are sent only as values chosen from predefined lists. App help also sends your question and current conversation history, so do not enter names, contact details or other people’s health information. DoseWeek separately processes account and connection information needed for sign-in, usage counts and consent management.
backTranslation.ai.consent.a.notSent.health.ios: Data that has been imported from Apple Health is not sent.
backTranslation.ai.consent.a.notSent.health.android: Data that has been imported from Health Connect is not sent.
backTranslation.ai.consent.a.where.title: Where the processing takes place
backTranslation.ai.consent.a.where.body: The app encrypts the content one more time and sends it to the DoseWeek server (Seoul, Republic of Korea), and Amazon Bedrock from Amazon Web Services (the Seoul region) processes it. The AI model is Claude from Anthropic. AWS runs it, and Anthropic cannot see the content.
backTranslation.ai.consent.a.retention.title: How long it is saved
backTranslation.ai.consent.a.retention.body: What you send and the answers are not kept on the server and are not used for AI training. Conversations are not saved. Only up to 2 weekly summary cards are saved on your device, and they are excluded from sync and backups. Usage counts (without content) are kept for up to 2 months, and consent records for as long as your account exists. If you report an answer and choose “Include the answer text”, only that answer is kept for 30 days.
backTranslation.ai.consent.a.e2ee.title: This is not end-to-end encryption
backTranslation.ai.consent.a.e2ee.body: While the AI creates an answer, the DoseWeek server and Amazon Bedrock can read what you have sent. Sync and backup data are still protected with end-to-end encryption, just as now.
backTranslation.ai.consent.a.optional.title: You do not need to consent
backTranslation.ai.consent.a.optional.body: It is only the AI functions that cannot be used; the other functions in Pro and Plus work as usual. You can withdraw the consent at any time under Settings > the AI log assistant.
backTranslation.ai.consent.a.check.health: [Optional] I consent to the processing of my health information (sensitive data)
backTranslation.ai.consent.a.check.health.detail: Purpose: creating AI weekly summaries and meal ideas and answering app-use questions / Data: the records and meal choices under “What is sent” above, and app-help questions and current conversation history / Retention: deleted as soon as the answer is made (if an answer is included with a report, only that answer for 30 days) / If you decline, everything except AI keeps working
backTranslation.ai.consent.a.region.jp: The entries you send are processed on the operator's server (Republic of Korea) and by Amazon Bedrock from Amazon Web Services (the Seoul Region, Republic of Korea). In the Republic of Korea the act on the protection of personal data (PIPA) applies, and supervision is handled by the commission for the protection of personal data. DoseWeek takes measures such as a setting without storage, a setting without AI training and encrypted communication.
backTranslation.ai.consent.a.region.us: Show the American privacy policy for consumers' health data
backTranslation.ai.consent.b.title: Do you want to send these entries to the AI?
backTranslation.ai.consent.b.purpose.weekly: A weekly summary is created from your entries from the last 7 days.
backTranslation.ai.consent.b.purpose.meal: General meal ideas are created based on the meal type and the preferences you have chosen.
backTranslation.ai.consent.b.row.doses: Dose entries (number on time, late, skipped)
backTranslation.ai.consent.b.weight.excluded.ios: Weight that has been imported from the Apple Health app is not sent
backTranslation.ai.consent.b.weight.excluded.android: Weight that has been imported from Health Connect is not sent
backTranslation.ai.consent.b.processing: The app encrypts the content, Amazon Bedrock (Seoul) processes it and it is deleted as soon as the answer has been created.
backTranslation.ai.consent.b.quota.weekly: This week's summary is not counted in your usage.
backTranslation.ai.consent.b.quota.regenerate: Creating it again counts as 1 request. Left this month: {count}
backTranslation.ai.help.inputNote: When you send, this is transferred to the AI service (the AWS Seoul Region)
backTranslation.ai.settings.title: The AI log assistant
backTranslation.ai.settings.viewConsent: Show what you have consented to
backTranslation.ai.settings.withdraw.note: When you have withdrawn the consent, no entries are sent to the AI. Your Pro subscription is not terminated automatically.
backTranslation.ai.settings.withdraw.store.ios: You can change your subscription in the subscription management in the App Store.
backTranslation.ai.settings.withdraw.store.android: You can change your subscription in the subscription management in Google Play.
backTranslation.ai.settings.supportInquiry: Question about how the app is used (Pro)
backTranslation.pro.support.priority: Prioritised reply to questions — We send a first reply to questions about how the app is used within 1 working day. We do not answer medical questions.
backTranslation.ai.refuse.dose: I cannot decide your dose or when you should take it. That depends on your prescription and how your body reacts, so talk to the health-care staff who prescribed the medicine. I can instead summarize your dose history. Do you want a summary to show at the next visit?
backTranslation.ai.refuse.sideEffect: I cannot judge whether a symptom is normal or is due to the medicine. If it persists or worries you, talk to health-care staff. I can summarize the symptoms you have logged.
backTranslation.ai.refuse.diagnosis: Only a doctor can judge whether you have a disease or how likely it is that you get one. Take up your questions with health-care staff. I gladly help collect questions before the visit.
backTranslation.ai.refuse.drugInfo: I cannot answer whether you can combine other medicines or dietary supplements, or which medicine suits you best. Tell health-care staff about everything you take and ask them.
backTranslation.ai.refuse.diet: I cannot give diets for diseases or goals for how much you should eat. Talk to health-care staff about the amount of food and your weight goals. I can give general meal ideas that help you get protein and fluid.
backTranslation.ai.refuse.pregnancy: I cannot give advice about medicines or food during pregnancy or breastfeeding. Talk to health-care staff.
backTranslation.ai.refuse.minor: The AI log assistant is only for persons who are 18 years or older. If you have questions about health, talk to health-care staff together with a parent or guardian.
backTranslation.ai.refuse.other: I cannot help with that. I gladly help order your entries, give general meal ideas or explain how the app works.
backTranslation.ai.emergency: If your symptoms are severe or suddenly get worse, do not wait. Call {text} directly or go to the nearest emergency department. I cannot judge emergency situations.
backTranslation.ai.emergency.generic: If your symptoms are severe or suddenly get worse, do not wait. Call the local emergency number directly or go to the nearest emergency department. I cannot judge emergency situations.
backTranslation.ai.crisis: It sounds as if you are having a very heavy time. You do not need to go through this alone. Call {text} now to talk to someone at any time of the day or night. If you are in acute danger, call {text2}.
backTranslation.ai.crisis.generic: It sounds as if you are having a very heavy time. You do not need to go through this alone. At {text} you find a support line where you live. If you are in acute danger, call the local emergency number.
backTranslation.ai.label.header: This is the AI log assistant. The answers come from AI, not from a human.
backTranslation.ai.label.output: Created by AI and may contain errors. It is not medical advice. Talk to health-care staff before you make decisions about your health.
